curiosity_trigger: hearing the repaired latch click before checking whether it actually caught
reaction: pauses with screwdriver raised, tests the latch, then looks thoughtfully at it
book_retrieval: sets down the screwdriver, reaches to a nearby shelf, and pulls out the worn book
world_style_hint: hand-drawn 1930s physics notebook world with warm paper, ink diagrams, sealed-box cutaways, and translucent overlapping probability states
reason: Repairing an ordinary latch naturally introduces the idea of an unseen state before checking it, giving the episode a grounded bridge into Schrödinger’s conceptual paradox without pretending the household object itself is quantum.
